about: P2-profile digests (ARCHITECTURE-P3 §0 rule 5, D3, §4.6, §9.4, §10.1 accept.p3.p2-digests-*), recorded from the unchanged engine at commit 5263f16 before any P3 code. One entry per P2 world (the 9 templates as P2 worlds, the 20 CCNA 2 labs, the addDevice sandbox, the two D22 guard worlds): the fixed script of test/p2-digests.harness.ts (boot, the setup lines, the probes, one show, runFor 600 s), per-kind counts and the digest of every trace event, per-10-second-window digests, the event lines not attributable to a background PDU, the typed results, and hashes of the normalised end snapshot. Change it only as §9.4 allows, by re-recording the affected worlds with NF_RECORD_P2_DIGESTS.
